about: Core test 3 (P29 *S3 build inputs*): anchors captured on `from` (prefix, suffix and start derived from its section text as the browser captures them: up to 32 characters either side) re-anchored on `to`. `text` is what the resolved offsets must cover in `to`'s section. `language` maps ids from `source` onto `target` (exact, else the nearest preceding id, else null).

cases.name: exact: same section, text shifted by an inserted paragraph
fuzzy: one word edited, similarity >= 0.8
cases.exact: trims the wick every evening before the fishing boats

expect.text: trims the wick each evening before the fishing boats

cases.name: fuzzy miss: the sentence rewritten, similarity < 0.8, the section stays
cases.exact: Whale oil burned bright but smelled of the sea

cases.name: moved: the sentence now in another section
moved: the section retired, the text kept elsewhere
orphan: the section retired and the text gone
block note on a surviving section
block note on a retired section
